# Clearing the Tower Cellars

*The Watch keeps a tally of the tower cellars. Knox pays for every forty lampbats cleared out of them, any night you like.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Urbanograd](../towns/urbanograd_quests.md) |
| Category | Repeatable |
| Given by | [Knox](../npcs/knox.md) |
| Level | 24 |

## Objectives

- Defeat 40 [Lampbat](../monsters/lampbat.md) in [The Outworks: Tower Cellars](../maps/outworks_cellars.md)

## Rewards

- 3,840 EXP
- 1,920 mesos
- +15 standing with Urbanograd

The first time you complete it instead: +40 standing with [Knox](../npcs/knox.md), +20 standing with Urbanograd
